export PATH=$PATH:/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools
echo "---ANR in logcat---"
adb logcat -d 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "ANR in|am_anr" | tail -5
echo "---Current top again---"
adb shell dumpsys activity activities 2>/dev/null | grep -E "ResumedActivity|topResumedActivity" | head -3
echo "---Screenshot pixel diversity via python---"
python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('/tmp/validate_shot.png').convert('RGB')
print('size', im.size)
im2 = im.resize((64,64))
colors = im2.getcolors(64*64)
print('distinct colors in 64x64 downscale:', len(colors))
import collections
top = collections.Counter(c for c in im2.getdata()).most_common(5)
print('top colors:', top)
" 2>&1 | head -8
